WHOLE PROMOTION, 8 of 8 functions, destructor pair included. The cartridge orders D1 (0x021118c8) BELOW D0 (0x02111928) -- the reproducible direction. mwccarm 2004/b56's destructor-variant lever set is closed and measured: a destructor defined in the class body emits D1 then D0 and nothing else, while an out-of-line definition emits D2, D0, D1 plus a homeless D2 the ROM does not carry. include/daDkk_c.h was moved to the in-class form for exactly that reason, and tubuild verify reports 8/8 MATCH with all eight sections in ROM-ascending emission order. This is the direction its own base class daDsnBase_c could NOT reproduce -- ov091 orders that one D0-below-D1, which is why daDsnBase_c promoted 9-of-11 while this leaf promotes whole.
